verified_facts.text: Argos is located in a small village in Uçhisar overlooking Pigeon Valley and Erciyes Mountain beyond.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in a small village in Uçhisar overlooking the undulating Pigeon Valley and the grand Erciyes Mountain beyond

verified_facts.text: Argos describes itself as a sustainable hotel deeply connected to the land, its history and its culture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Argos is a sustainable hotel of refined details, deeply connected to the land, its history and its culture.

verified_facts.text: Argos is laid out as a village-within-a-village of terraces ascending into the valley, with snaking paths leading to its rooms, pools, restaurants and gardens.
